name: Kookne
sum: Maastrichtian ornithuran from the Chorrillo Formation of Santa Cruz, Argentina, known from a coracoid.
holotype: A coracoid (number in Novas et al. 2019).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Novas et al. 2019
